summary: Reverses one wide-character read: increments the dword at the pointer stored in this+0x2C and subtracts 2 from the dword at the pointer stored in this+0x1C, returning the adjusted value. Shape matches a two-byte putback/ungetc on a wide-character buffer. Called by FileOffsetPositionValidation.

local_names.this: stream/buffer object whose this+0x1C and this+0x2C hold pointers to the position and count dwords

operations.description: Increments the dword value at the pointer stored in this+0x2C by one; interpreted as raising an available/remaining count when one character is put back.
Subtracts 2 from the dword value at the pointer stored in this+0x1C; interpreted as moving a byte-oriented buffer position back by two bytes (one wide character).
Returns the adjusted value read through this+0x1C after the two-byte step-back.
Called by FileOffsetPositionValidation (0x0059A01E), which supplies the this object on its offset-validation path.

unresolved: The two-byte step-back is consistent with a wide-character (two-byte) putback, but the exact encoding/width contract behind this+0x1C and this+0x2C is DERIVED, not independently confirmed.
Equal offsets on unrelated this pointers elsewhere are not proof the fields or owner class are identical.
